next_step_summary: PR #222 is a bounded safety corrective for two defects proven by targeted audit of PR #221. Boundary occupancy is now evaluated directly in fixed-frame deskew coordinates so the accepted 1-degree, sole content_touches_frame, roughly 15-percent clear-background case can reach cropped_grayscale without post-rotation AABB inflation. Recovery also fails closed when meaningful paper-classified pixels or a substantial intermediate-luminance shadow band remains outside the proposed crop, preserving the PR #220 deskewed full-frame fallback for shadowed, trapezoidal or otherwise uncertain physical edges. Focused synthetic production-Kotlin checks cover shadow/signature and trapezoid/signature fallback, the clear 1-degree crop path, normal and inverted polarity, 3:1 support and ambiguous 2:2 rejection. Existing normal accepted safe-crop behavior, angle estimation, perspective behavior, OCR/network/provider/dependency/permission/workflow behavior and privacy boundary are unchanged. Continue android-document-preprocess-device-smoke-v1 on the owner-controlled photographed regression page and contract sets; no real-device PASS is recorded by PR #222.
